subject: Add execution-bias prompt + warm-start memory reuse to ARC bench
description: Two changes to enable an execution-biased warm-start re-run. (1) adapter.py zonoid_task_instructions: add an OPERATING MODE block (explore until a CANDIDATE PATH exists, then COMMIT and EXECUTE the move sequence; only return to EXPLORE on a contradiction; bias hard toward acting, max ~2-3 explore turns before committing) and change step 3 DECIDE to ACT (advance committed plan if executing, else probe+commit). (2) runner.py: add --reuse-data-dir and --reuse-workspace flags; in run_benchmarking_repo when both set, skip mkdtemp and start the daemon with daemon_mod.start(workspace=reuse_workspace, data_dir=reuse_data_dir) so the daemon reopens the prior run's overlay (its ~30 ls20 transition notes) and the agent recalls them via /search. Thread both flags through main() and run_real. Verify: py_compile, --help shows flags, --dry-run ok.
